D.title: Historical original defect

E.title: Justified correction of a real defect
E.strongest_evidence_against: Evidence that the predecessor behavior was already correct or that this change introduced unnecessary scope unrelated to the verified failure.
E.contrary_found: The predecessor defect is concrete in review/history and the change addresses the same boundary without requiring unrelated subsystem expansion.

F.title: Supporting/provenance-only record
F.strongest_evidence_against: An independent product/architecture mechanism in this row that would require its own correctness verdict.
F.contrary_found: The row records state, scope, CI/deployment observation, evidence limitation, test evidence, or later synchronization. It is not used as self-validating authority for neighboring decisions.

G.title: Evidence-limited test/document contract question
G.strongest_evidence_against: Evidence that current exact-seed assertions are intentionally immutable across future locale lifecycle changes, or conversely a concrete current/future migration that is already blocked by them.
G.contrary_found: Current tests still assert the exact current ru/he/ka final state, while docs treat locale lifecycle data as mutable. But no later migration currently needs different locale data, and ordinary tests can be updated with such a migration.
G.effect: Insufficient evidence to call EX29-13 a present defect or a harmless permanent contract.

H.title: Hyperdrive client lifecycle alternative
H.strongest_evidence_against: Official/current platform guidance requiring explicit client.end() for per-invocation Hyperdrive clients, or evidence of cross-request client reuse/resource leakage.
H.contrary_found: Current Cloudflare Hyperdrive connection-lifecycle guidance explicitly says Workers-to-Hyperdrive clients are automatically cleaned up at invocation end and client.end() is not required; current code creates a new client per request load.
H.effect: Acceptable alternative; EX23-18 is not established as a current client-leak defect.
